item.title: Borges, ballet and BDSM: 10 must-see movies at Edinburgh international film festival
item.summary: The great Argentinian’s Highlands holiday, a mischievous doc about Jack the Ripper, the hypnotic latest from Nicolas Winding Refn and a kinky noir romp are among the best of this year’s lineup • Edinburgh international film festival showcases a Scottish industry in rude health George MacKay gives a viscerally intense performance in a new film from For Those in Peril ’s Paul Wright. He plays a troubled restaurant worker called Dylan, who snaps during his asinine corporate “performance assessment” and heads off on an anguished and violent journey of despair into his own past.
